SANTHOSH KUMAR.K Mobile: 8825652577 E-Mail: Santhosh2documents@gmail.com Address: 21/3 Brindavan street, West Mambalam, Chennai -600033 Seeking Business Analyst/Consultant Role in Product development Sector with an organization of high repute and to expand my career growth.

SYNOPSIS

Business Analyst / Product Owner with 10+ years of experience across Banking, Financial Services, Payments Operations and FinTech, with strong experience in business requirements, process transformation, AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, BPMN process modelling, workflow optimization and Agile product delivery. Experienced in supporting end-to-end operating model transformation, analyzing current-state processes, identifying business and operational gaps, and defining future-state workflows to support process improvement, automation and digital transformation. Experienced in working with global distributed teams and cross-functional stakeholders across Business, Technology, Operations, Finance and Risk functions.

CORE SKILLS

➢ Business Analysis & Requirements Management ➢ Target Operating Model (TOM) Transformation ➢ AS-IS / TO-BE Process Analysis ➢ Business Process Mapping & BPMN Modelling ➢ Process Optimization & Re-engineering ➢ Business Transformation & Change Management ➢ Product Ownership & Product Development ➢ Agile / Scrum Methodology

➢ Stakeholder & Relationship Management ➢ Root Cause & Gap Analysis ➢ UAT & Functional Testing ➢ Data Analysis & Documentation ➢ Prompt Engineering & AI-enabled Business

Analysis

➢ Hands-on experience in working with the Client during UAT ➢ Managed Platinum Service Module - PSM team which is designated only for premium clients of Citibank. ➢ Winner of the Innovation idea award from RRD Donnelley ➢ Proficient in Client interacting ➢ Experience in Preparing the BRD Documents
